sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我曾在凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中走过的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想去看看下一颗恒星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费者产品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的首字母单词开始。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址 nytimes.com 加上 subscribe。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Bovaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·博瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The story of how the fallout from Alex Preddy's death forced President Trump to change course in Minneapolis and the debate over whether those changes are real or merely symbolic.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·普雷迪之死的余波，如何迫使特朗普总统在明尼阿波利斯改变方针，以及关于这些改变是真是假、抑或只是象征性的辩论。

sentences.en: I spoke with White House reporters Zolan Kano-Yums and Tyler Pager.
sentences.zh: 我采访了白宫记者佐兰·卡诺-尤姆斯和泰勒·佩杰。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, January 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月28日，星期三。

sentences.en: Zolan and Tyler, we are having this conversation with you on Tuesday afternoon at this moment when President Trump has clearly decided to try to telegraph
sentences.zh: 佐兰和泰勒，我们正在周二下午与你们进行这段对话，当时特朗普总统显然已经决定试图暗示

sentences.en: that he wants to change course or at least change the tone around his administration's immigration crackdown in Minneapolis
sentences.zh: 他想要改变方针，或者至少改变他的政府在明尼阿波利斯打击非法移民行动的基调

sentences.en: following the killing of Alex Preddy and all of the outrage it inspired.
sentences.zh: 在亚历克斯·普雷迪被杀以及由此引发的所有愤怒之后。

sentences.en: And we're going to talk about how meaningful or superficial that change really is.
sentences.zh: 我们要谈谈这种改变究竟有多大意义，还是仅仅流于表面。

sentences.en: But Tyler, let's first talk through what's actually happened behind the scenes in the days since Preddy's death.
sentences.zh: 但泰勒，我们首先来聊聊在普雷迪死后的这几天里，幕后究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: So, Michael, one of the interesting things just about this weekend is that it's one of the rare weekends in the winter where Donald Trump is in Washington
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，关于这个周末，有趣的事情之一就是这是唐纳德·特朗普少有的留在华盛顿度过的冬日周末

sentences.en: and not in Palm Beach, Florida at his club and residence, Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 而不是在佛罗里达州棕榈滩他的俱乐部和住所海湖庄园。

sentences.en: And the reason that Trump stayed in Washington was because he was hosting a special premiere at the White House for the new documentary about his wife, Melania.
sentences.zh: 特朗普留在华盛顿的原因是他在白宫为关于他妻子梅拉尼娅的新纪录片主持一场特别首映式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so the president is spending a lot of the weekend in the Oval Office and in the dining room off the Oval Office watching media coverage of what's going on in Minneapolis
sentences.zh: 所以总统周末的大量时间都在椭圆形办公室以及椭圆形办公室旁的餐厅里度过，观看关于明尼阿波利斯局势发展的媒体报道

sentences.en: and the shooting of Alex Preddy.
sentences.zh: 还有亚历克斯·普雷迪的枪击案。

sentences.en: He spent a lot of the time watching Fox News, but flips around channels.
sentences.zh: 他花了很多时间看福克斯新闻，但也经常换台。

sentences.en: Another American citizen has been shot dead by federal agents in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 另一名美国公民在明尼阿波利斯被联邦特工开枪打死。

sentences.en: The Trump administration is defending the agents' actions.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府正在为特工的行为辩护。

sentences.en: And just saw this cacophony of voices criticizing the response and the killing of this man in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚看到这种杂乱的声音，都在批评明尼阿波利斯的应对方式和对这个男人的谋杀。

sentences.en: It should freak the American public out that the Trump administration lies this easily, will lie to your face when you can see the evidence for yourself.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府撒谎撒得如此轻易，甚至能在你亲眼看到证据时当面说谎，这应该让美国公众感到恐慌。

sentences.en: He was called by the Trump administration officials a domestic terrorist when all he had in his hand was a cell phone.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府官员称他为国内恐怖分子，而他手里拿的其实只有一个手机。

sentences.en: Americans don't like what they're seeing right now.
sentences.zh: 美国人不喜欢他们现在看到的这一切。

sentences.en: Nobody likes feds coming into their state.
sentences.zh: 没有人喜欢联邦特工进入他们的州。

sentences.en: And so what's the goal right now?
sentences.zh: 那么现在的目标是什么呢？

sentences.en: And this criticism is notable and rare because it's not just Democrats and it's not the usual loudest critics in the Republican Party that are pushing back on him.
sentences.zh: 这种批评既显眼又罕见，因为不仅是民主党人，甚至连共和党内那些平日里声音最大的批评者也在对他进行回击。

sentences.en: Senator Bill Cassidy calling the situation disturbing, writing the credibility of ICE and DHS are at stake.
sentences.zh: 参议员比尔·卡西迪称这一局势令人不安，并写道移民及海关执法局和国土安全部的信誉正处于危急关头。

sentences.en: You've got Senator Bill Cassidy who said on social media that the shooting was incredibly disturbing.
sentences.zh: 参议员比尔·卡西迪在社交媒体上表示，这次枪击事件令人极其不安。

sentences.en: Tom Tillis called for an investigation as well.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·蒂利斯也呼吁展开调查。

sentences.en: That's notable pushback against this White House, particularly a White House that demands loyalty from its party.
sentences.zh: 这是对这个白宫罕见的强烈回击，特别是对于一个要求党内保持忠诚的白宫而言。

sentences.en: And beyond the Republican lawmakers, even some sympathetic media figures like Fox News host Trey Gowdy and Maria Bartiroma were also criticizing the rhetoric
sentences.zh: 除了共和党议员，甚至一些同情立场的媒体名流，比如福克斯新闻主持人特雷·高迪和玛丽亚·巴蒂罗马，也批评了

sentences.en: from senior administration officials.
sentences.zh: 高级行政官员的言论。

sentences.en: You've collected the evidence, you said, right?
sentences.zh: 你们已经收集了证据，对吧？

sentences.en: You have the handgun in your possession?
sentences.zh: 你们手里有那把手枪吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And how was he using that handgun in terms of threatening Border Patrol?
sentences.zh: 他当时是如何使用那把手枪来威胁边境巡逻队的？

sentences.en: What was the threat?
sentences.zh: 威胁到底是什么？

sentences.en: He had his camera, right?
sentences.zh: 他拿着相机，对吧？

sentences.en: He was filming it.
sentences.zh: 他在拍摄。

sentences.en: And, Michael, that's to say nothing of what Trump would have seen if he tuned into MSNOW or CNN.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这还不算如果特朗普收看微观新闻或有线电视新闻网会看到的内容。

sentences.en: What do you see when you watch those videos?
sentences.zh: 你看着那些视频时看到了什么？

sentences.en: An execution.
sentences.zh: 一场处决。

sentences.en: An absolute execution.
sentences.zh: 绝对是一场处决。

sentences.en: He, there's no, every angle shows it.
sentences.zh: 他，没有任何疑问，每一个角度都显示了这一点。

sentences.en: And they continued to fire bullets at him while his body was lifeless on the ground.
sentences.zh: 当他的身体毫无生息地躺在地上时，他们继续向他开枪。

sentences.en: Where officials were saying that the government basically gunned down this man and bungled the response.
sentences.zh: 而官员们却声称政府基本上枪杀了这个男人，并且把应对工作搞砸了。

sentences.en: The lies do more than mislead.
sentences.zh: 谎言不仅仅是误导。

sentences.en: They justify the unjustifiable.
sentences.zh: 它们是在为主张无理的事情辩护。

sentences.en: And in the absence of accountability from the Department of Homeland Security, from ICE, from Customs and Border Protection, it is up to us to hold on to the truth.
sentences.zh: 在国土安全部、移民及海关执法局以及海关与边境保护局缺乏问责的情况下，我们要靠自己来坚守真相。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I caught some of that coverage.
sentences.zh: 我看到了其中的一些报道。

sentences.en: And it was basically, the government has murdered this man and then systematically lied about what happened in the face of video that very clearly contradicted it.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是，政府谋杀了这个人，然后面对明显与之矛盾的视频，系统性地撒谎掩盖发生了什么。

sentences.en: Absolutely, Michael.
sentences.zh: 完全如此，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And what the president was concerned about was not necessarily the incident itself.
sentences.zh: 总统关心的其实不一定是这起事件本身。

sentences.en: You know, he was disturbed that a man had been killed.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有人被杀让他感到不安。

sentences.en: But, Michael, what he was really worried about was that this chaos, this narrative, was overshadowing all of the progress he felt he has made
sentences.zh: 但是，迈克尔，他真正担心的是，这种混乱和这种叙事正在掩盖他认为自己已经取得的所有进展

sentences.en: on the issue of immigration enforcement and the border with Mexico.
sentences.zh: 在移民执法以及与墨西哥边境问题上。

sentences.en: So these are issues that are core to his political identity.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是他政治身份的核心问题。

sentences.en: And the president was talking to aides and allies throughout the weekend and venting about how the narrative was being overtaken by this use of force and by the killing of a man.
sentences.zh: 整个周末，总统都在与助手和盟友交谈，并宣泄情绪，抱怨叙事被这种武力使用和一个人的死亡所掩盖。

sentences.en: And it was distracting from the message that he wanted to be driving home, which was that he had sealed the border and he was getting rid of, in his parlance,
sentences.zh: 这分散了他想要极力传达的信息，那就是他已经封锁了边境，并且用他自己的话说，他正在清除

sentences.en: the most violent, undocumented immigrants in the country.
sentences.zh: 国内最暴力的无证移民。

sentences.en: And, Joel, when did we start to see him reacting accordingly?
sentences.zh: 乔尔，我们是什么时候开始看到他做出相应反应的？

sentences.en: Late Sunday night, an interview with the Wall Street Journal published with President Trump, in which he made somewhat measured comments for him.
sentences.zh: 周日深夜，特朗普总统接受《华尔街日报》采访的报道发表了，他在采访中发表了对他而言算得上比较克制的言论。

sentences.en: He actually expressed a willingness in an investigation into this shooting and said that his administration was reviewing the shooting
sentences.zh: 他实际上表示愿意对这次枪击事件展开调查，并称他的政府正在审查这起枪击事件

sentences.en: and that eventually they would come out of determination.
sentences.zh: 最终他们会得出结论。

sentences.en: These comments are starkly different from the way the president was talking about this shooting even just 24 hours before, right?
sentences.zh: 这些言论与总统仅仅在24小时前谈论这起枪击事件的方式有着天壤之别，对吧？

sentences.en: In the initial aftermath,
sentences.zh: 在最初的余波中，

sentences.en: President Trump once again laid blame on the victim.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统再次将责任归咎于受害者。

sentences.en: He attacked local leaders in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 他攻击了明尼苏达州的地方领袖。

sentences.en: Now he's coming out and actually saying that they want to take a look at this.
sentences.zh: 现在他站出来，实际上说他们想要调查此事。

sentences.en: That is really different than the usual reactionary defense we see from President Trump when it comes to anything really involving ICE or his immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 这与我们平时看到特朗普总统在涉及移民及海关执法局或其移民议程的任何事情时做出的本能防御大不相同。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it turns out that ends up, Tyler, being kind of just the beginning
sentences.zh: 结果证明，泰勒，这似乎只是一个开始

sentences.en: of a pretty public pivot that I wonder if you can keep describing here.
sentences.zh: 这是一场相当公开的转向，我想知道你是否能继续描述一下。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It starts very early Monday morning when the president announces on True Social that he's sending in Tom Homan, the White House border czar, from Washington to Minneapolis
sentences.zh: 这一切开始得很早，在周一清晨，当总统在真实社交平台上宣布他将派遣白宫边境沙皇汤姆·霍曼从华盛顿前往明尼阿波利斯

sentences.en: to lead the operation.
sentences.zh: 来领导这次行动。

sentences.en: And a few hours later, we learn that Greg Bovino, a top Border Patrol official who had been leading these operations all over the country, would be leaving Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，我们得知一直在全国各地领导这些行动的顶级边境巡逻官员格雷格·博维诺将离开明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: And it's a clear sign that changes are underway, at least in terms of personnel, in response to this horrible kill.
sentences.zh: 这是一个明显的信号，表明为了回应这起可怕的谋杀案，变革正在进行中，至少在人事方面是这样。

sentences.en: And the Bovino departure, just to linger on that for a minute, feels especially notable because he had literally been on the ground in Minneapolis very unapologetically defending
sentences.zh: 而博维诺的离开，如果在这个问题上多停留一会儿的话，会觉得格外引人注目，因为他当时确实亲身在明尼阿波利斯，毫不掩饰地为

sentences.en: the most aggressive tactics that ICE and Border Patrol were using.
sentences.zh: 移民及海关执法局和边境巡逻队采取的最具攻击性的战术进行辩护。

sentences.en: And because he had told the public something that turned out to be completely wrong about Alex Preddy and about his intent and his actions that was very much contradicted
sentences.zh: 并且因为他曾向公众透露了一些关于亚历克斯·普雷迪以及他的意图和行动的完全错误的信息，这些信息与

sentences.en: by the videos that emerged.
sentences.zh: 后来出现的视频内容严重矛盾。

sentences.en: And so suddenly it felt like there were consequences for that conduct.
sentences.zh: 所以突然之间，人们觉得这种行为是要承担后果的。

sentences.en: Absolutely, Michael.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, it wasn't just Bovino who was spreading these false messages about Preddy.
sentences.zh: 我认为，不仅仅是博维诺在散布关于普雷迪的这些虚假信息。

sentences.en: They were echoed by
sentences.zh: 这些言论也得到了以下人员的呼应

sentences.en: Kristi Noem, the Secretary of Homeland Security,
sentences.zh: 国土安全部长克里斯蒂·诺姆，

sentences.en: Stephen Miller, a senior advisor in the White House who is the architect of much of Trump's immigration agenda.
sentences.zh: 白宫高级顾问斯蒂芬·米勒，他是特朗普许多移民议程的操盘手。

sentences.en: And the president was distancing himself from those exact messages.
sentences.zh: 而总统正在与这些具体的言论保持距离。

sentences.en: He was not saying that Preddy was a domestic terrorist as Stephen Miller said.
sentences.zh: 他没有像斯蒂芬·米勒那样说普雷迪是国内恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And he also was not saying that Preddy was an assassin who was trying to inflict mass harm on Border Patrol agents as Kristi Noem suggested and Bovino did as well.
sentences.zh: 他也没有像克里斯蒂·诺姆和博维诺所暗示的那样，说普雷迪是企图对边境巡逻特工造成大规模伤害的刺客。

sentences.en: And so those individuals who were really spreading the most inaccurate messages about the victim were sort of being pushed aside.
sentences.zh: 因此，那些真正散布关于受害者的最不准确信息的个人在某种程度上被排挤在一边。

sentences.en: And on top of that, deciding to pull back
sentences.zh: 除此之外，决定撤回

sentences.en: Greg Bovino, we also hear that President Trump is having these phone calls with Governor Tim Waltz and the mayor of Minneapolis as well, Jacob Fry.
sentences.zh: 格雷格·博维诺，我们还听说特朗普总统与明尼苏达州长蒂姆·沃尔兹以及明尼阿波利斯市长雅各布·弗雷进行了电话交谈。

sentences.en: This is also pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这也是相当了不起的。

sentences.en: Just a couple days earlier,
sentences.zh: 就在几天前，

sentences.en: President Trump was attacking these same officials, blaming them for the unrest that we are seeing in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统还在攻击这些官员，将我们在明尼阿波利斯看到的动乱归咎于他们。

sentences.en: Right, and in fact, his Department of Justice is actively investigating both of them criminally for blocking his immigration crackdown.
sentences.zh: 没错，事实上，他的司法部正在积极对他们两人进行刑事调查，指控他们阻挠他的移民打击行动。

sentences.en: But suddenly, he's having what, by all accounts, I think are somewhat diplomatic phone calls.
sentences.zh: 但突然之间，他进行了无论从哪个角度来看我都认为是颇具外交意味的电话交谈。

sentences.en: He doesn't just talk to them.
sentences.zh: 他不只是跟他们通话。

sentences.en: He also describes it kind of positively as well.
sentences.zh: 他还以相当积极的方式描述了这件事。

sentences.en: And based on the readouts from the calls, Michael, it seems that they really did get into some substantive issues.
sentences.zh: 从通话纪要来看，迈克尔，他们似乎确实切入了一些实质性问题。

sentences.en: But I had two very good talks.
sentences.zh: 但我进行了两次非常愉快的交谈。

sentences.en: I had Jacob Fry and I had Governor Walz.
sentences.zh: 我跟雅各布·弗雷谈了，我还跟沃尔兹州长谈了。

sentences.en: And, I mean, they were great calls.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些都是很棒的通话。

sentences.en: As, you know, the president made clear that he wanted to enhance cooperation between state and local officials with federal officials on the ground.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，总统明确表示，他希望加强州和地方官员与当地联邦官员之间的合作。

sentences.en: and the Democratic leaders also pushed back.
sentences.zh: 民主党领袖也进行了反击。

sentences.en: First of all, I ask that we have a fair and independent
sentences.zh: 首先，我要求对谋杀雷内·古德和亚历克斯的事件展开公正独立的

sentences.en: investigation into the murder of both Rene Good and Alex
sentences.zh: 调查

sentences.en: and that we have to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 并且我们必须能够做到这一点。

sentences.en: And he said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: we'll look at that.
sentences.zh: 我们会看看这个。

sentences.en: We'll take a look at that.
sentences.zh: 我们会调查一下。

sentences.en: They said they wanted a real investigation into the shootings of Minneapolis residents.
sentences.zh: 他们表示希望对明尼阿波利斯居民遭枪击事件进行真正的调查。

sentences.en: And also, a readout from
sentences.zh: 此外，根据

sentences.en: Tim Walz's office said that the president agreed to look into reducing the number of federal agents in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·沃尔兹办公室发布的一份纪要显示，总统同意研究减少明尼苏达州联邦特工数量。

sentences.en: He pledged that, look,
